title: Communication Profile
description: A schema defining channel-specific communication constraints, safety rules, and escalation protocols.

sms_max_length.description: The maximum character limit for SMS messages.

sms_style_notes.description: Specific stylistic guidelines for SMS communication (e.g., use of abbreviations).

email_style_notes.description: Guidelines for email structure, tone, and formatting.

webchat_style_notes.description: Guidelines for real-time web chat interactions.

phone_script_style_notes.description: Instructions regarding the pace, tone, and delivery of phone scripts.

safety_rules.description: A list of rules to ensure the physical or psychological safety of the user/customer.

compliance_notes.description: Legal or regulatory requirements that must be followed in communications.

escalation_triggers.description: Specific keywords or situations that require the interaction to be handed off to a supervisor.
